content.comment_body: Hello! I'm a beginner with [company_name] [product_name] programming and looking for some guidance. I'm trying to build a system to automatically feed my rabbits while on vacation. The setup is similar to the design in [product_name] Web Editor, but I'd like to add extra features. I want to start the water supply for a set period and be able to adjust this timer through the interface as shown (see arrow in picture). Also, I'm unsure how to create a data log in the Web Editor, or if it's possible to add a real-time popup notification when an action occurs. Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you.
1. If you know how, changing the time value is straightforward. 2. Data logging through the web server isn't possible in this way. 3. You can enable a type of popup notification.

If you need an example, specify which [product_name] you are using (provide the [article_no]) and which version of the Web Editor. Alternatively, you can upload your Web Editor project and [product_name] program in a ZIP file so I can apply changes directly to the software.
Here's what I've started with: [product_name] with model [article_no], [product_name] software version [version_no], Web Editor latest version.
Your Web Editor isn't up to date. The latest release is [version_no].
What do you mean by 'any suggestion'? Are you asking where to download the current version [version_no]?
I'm looking for advice about the topic, not version updates. How can I change the timer that's activated by input I5 through the Web Editor interface?

I have the Web Editor version [version_no]. Unfortunately, I can't modify your project because the software would upgrade it to [version_no], and you wouldn't be able to open it with your earlier version. I can make changes in the [product_name] program if needed. For Web Editor, I can only provide screenshots. Edit: Using all capital letters in forum posts suggests you're upset. Is that your intention?

No worries, no one is upset. In my daily work, I get a bit impatient if discussions go off-topic. If you're willing to help, please make adjustments in the [product_name] software, and for the Web Editor just handle the timer part so I can change it as needed later. Don't worry about the software version; I’ll update to the latest as soon as I get home. Thank you.
The modified files are attached. In the [product_name] software, check the Parameter-VM-Mapping. In the Web Editor, use scaled time instead of analog values.
Thank you for the solution! I was close to figuring it out but missed addressing the timer state in parameter VM mapping.

But you used analog values instead of scaled time. Analog values don't support time formats like hh:mm:ss; they're simply a total based on the time unit. For example, if seconds are the unit and you set 1 minute and 35 seconds, the analog value will be 95 (1 x 60 + 35). If you want 2 minutes and 41 seconds, enter 161 (2 x 60 + 41).

I meant I was close in another attempt, not in the example I sent you! From your example, I only used the [product_name] program, since I couldn't open the Web Editor without updating. I've properly set the time fields and now see minutes and seconds in both 'set' and 'remaining' fields. Thanks anyway!

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces difficulties modifying timer durations for an automatic water supply system using the [product_name] Web Editor interface, and they also request features like real-time notifications and data logging. Usability issues revolve around the timer adjustment method and limitations for adding notifications or data logs within the Web Editor. There's also confusion over version compatibility that restricts direct file updates.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to conveniently modify timer durations via the web interface, implement real-time notifications or logs, and receive clear, tailored instructions or examples matched to their hardware and software versions.
